# InstrumentContract

`schemas/records/instrument-contract.json`

Registration of an instrument before it may produce receipts (docs/design/m0/06 "Instrument contracts"). Cross-field rules (no predicate both required and optional, artifact names used by receipts) belong to internal/receipt.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |
| `version` | yes | string (minLength `1`) |  |
| `digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | Hash of the code and configuration that produce receipts. |
| `subject_type` | yes | one of `tree`, `proposal`, `object_revision`, `environment`, `call` |  |
| `required_predicates` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-required_predicates)) (minItems `1`) | The coverage a complete receipt must have. |
| `optional_predicates` | yes | array of [Name](records-receipt.md#name) (unique items) |  |
| `preconditions` | yes | array of [Name](records-receipt.md#name) (unique items) | Environment checks before each run (12); a failure is a precondition_failed hold, not a spent attempt. |
| `payload_schema` | yes | null or [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | Blob digest of the JSON Schema for typed predicate fields (rule 7); null means the instrument's predicates carry no payload. |
| `artifact_classes` | yes | map of [Name](records-receipt.md#name) to one of `diagnostic`, `restricted` |  |

No other fields are allowed.
